name: vibe-coding-marketplace
description: Vibe Coding Marketplace —— 交易「能运行的作品」的在线市场（课程项目）

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @vibe/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @vibe/api" "npm run dev -w @vibe/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vibe/shared && npm run build -w @vibe/api && npm run build -w @vibe/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @vibe/shared && npm run test -ws --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @vibe/shared && npm run typecheck -w @vibe/shared && npm run typecheck -w @vibe/api && npm run typecheck -w @vibe/web
